form_drafts_one_scope.name: form_drafts_one_scope
form_drafts_one_scope.value:
("form_drafts"."template_id" IS NOT NULL AND "form_drafts"."observation_cycle_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("form_drafts"."template_id" IS NULL AND "form_drafts"."observation_cycle_id" IS NOT NULL)

form_drafts_pairing_needs_template.name: form_drafts_pairing_needs_template
form_drafts_pairing_needs_template.value: "form_drafts"."pairing_id" IS NULL OR "form_drafts"."template_id" IS NOT NULL

jobs_dedupe_live_uq.name: jobs_dedupe_live_uq
jobs_dedupe_live_uq.where: dedupe_key IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('queued', 'running')

phases_dates_check.name: phases_dates_check
phases_dates_check.value: "phases"."start_date" IS NULL OR "phases"."end_date" IS NULL OR "phases"."end_date" >= "phases"."start_date"

quizzes_one_scope.name: quizzes_one_scope
quizzes_one_scope.value:
("quizzes"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quizzes"."rtt_subject_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("quizzes"."subject_id" IS NULL AND "quizzes"."rtt_subject_id" IS NOT NULL)

resources_has_source_check.name: resources_has_source_check
resources_has_source_check.value: "resources"."file_key" IS NOT NULL OR "resources"."external_url" IS NOT NULL

subjects_grades_min_le_max_check.name: subjects_grades_min_le_max_check
subjects_grades_min_le_max_check.value: "subjects"."grades_min" IS NULL OR "subjects"."grades_max" IS NULL OR "subjects"."grades_min" <= "subjects"."grades_max"

video_submissions_ready_requires_hls_che.name: video_submissions_ready_requires_hls_check
video_submissions_ready_requires_hls_che.value: "video_submissions"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("video_submissions"."hls_master_key" IS NOT NULL AND "video_submissions"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
